entry.title: Photonic band structure by direct second-kind free-space boundary integral equations
entry.summary:
We present a direct boundary integral equation (BIE) formulation of the Bloch eigenvalue problem for two-dimensional photonic crystals that uses only the free-space Helmholtz Green function. The unknowns are the Cauchy data of the Bloch mode on the inclusion boundary and on two cell walls. On the inclusion boundary, the transmission conditions are imposed via Müller's formulation.

Source: arXiv Analysis, PDEs & Probability (AP, PR, NA, OC) · Tags: #analysis-pde #probability-stats #optics-photonics #post-quantum

entry.title: CO$Φ$ - COmpiling PHotonics into dIgital quantum circuits. Photonic and qubit-based (digital) approaches to quantum computing are largely regarded as separate paradigms.
entry.summary:
Photonic and qubit-based (digital) approaches to quantum computing are largely regarded as separate paradigms. This article aims to bridge these paradigms by developing a method for mapping quantum-optical systems onto qubit-based quantum circuits. The key ingredient enabling this mapping is the introduction of a truncation of the Fock space describing single-mode optical states.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #compilers #optics-photonics

entry.title: Fibres and glasses are competing material states in protein condensation
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03415-z Fibres are thought to emerge from a dense protein condensate ageing into a glassy state. It is now shown that protein fibres and glassy condensates may result from two competing ageing pathways.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #genomics-proteins

entry.title: Light-induced asymmetric pseudogap below the critical temperature in cuprates
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03446-6 How superconductivity relates to the pseudogap in cuprates remains unclear. Now, time-resolved photoemission measurements show a light-induced pseudogap-like state below critical temperature, revealing a dynamic interplay with superconductivity.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #condensed-matter

entry.title: A liquid-crystal analogue of the skyrmion Hall effect
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03379-0 Magnetic skyrmions are known to exhibit a Hall effect in the presence of an electric current. Now it is shown that liquid-crystal solitons also exhibit a Hall-like drift under shear flow.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics
